name: Toothache
description: Pain in or around a tooth, often indicating decay or infection.

name: Sensitive teeth
description: Pain or discomfort when exposed to hot or cold stimuli.

name: Bleeding gums
description: Gum bleeding during brushing or flossing, often a sign of gingivitis.

name: Sore gums
description: Gum tenderness or soreness, can accompany gum disease.

name: Mouth sores
description: Ulcers or lesions inside the mouth, including canker sores.

name: Bad breath
description: Persistent halitosis from poor hygiene or infection.

name: Dry mouth
description: Reduced saliva flow causing discomfort and increased decay risk.

name: Jaw pain
description: Pain around the jaw area, possibly linked to TMJ or abscess.

name: Swollen gums
description: Enlarged gums, often due to inflammation or infection.

name: Dental abscess
description: Localized pus formation from a bacterial infection in the tooth or gums.

name: Cracked tooth
description: Fracture or crack in tooth causing sharp pain or sensitivity.

name: Loose tooth
description: Tooth mobility, often due to gum disease or trauma.

name: Receding gums
description: Gum recession exposing tooth roots, increasing sensitivity.

name: Tooth discoloration
description: Change in tooth color due to staining or enamel damage.

name: Metalic taste
description: Unusual taste in the mouth, sometimes tied to gum disease.

name: Throbbing pain
description: Pulsating dental pain, often indicative of abscess or pulpitis.

name: Popping jaw
description: Clicking or popping sound in jaw during movement (TMJ-related).

name: Gum redness
description: Red coloration of gums, often early sign of gum inflammation.

name: Ulcer in mouth
description: Open sore, like aphthous ulcer or canker sore inside the mouth.

name: Difficulty chewing
description: Pain or discomfort when biting or chewing food.
